candidates.hypothesis: Rebuild the current full-block Canon reference as a paired development-split control.

candidates.title: temporal_depth_memory
candidates.hypothesis: Causal two-lag depth keys let four channel groups independently retrieve block deltas after Canon-filtered sublayers. This should specialize local and semantic retrieval without increasing model width.

candidates.title: temporal_depth_memory
candidates.hypothesis: Causal two-lag depth keys let four channel groups independently retrieve block deltas after Canon-filtered sublayers. A separately addressable context-gated bigram/trigram source should free attention capacity for reasoning.

candidates.title: two_scale_lexical_depth
candidates.hypothesis: A gated FFN can use separate near and dilated causal filters for its gate and carrier, complementing channel-wise depth retrieval and lexical memory at matched matrix FLOPs.

candidates.title: lexical_stream_canon
candidates.hypothesis: A context-gated bigram and trigram embedding can seed multi-scale temporal depth streams. Local convolution on Q, K, V and the FFN hidden should then let those streams focus on longer dependencies.

candidates.title: temporal_depth_memory
candidates.hypothesis: With identical depth routing, increasing each hash table fourfold should reduce lexical collisions enough to improve longer-horizon generalization.

candidates.title: temporal_depth_memory
candidates.hypothesis: At matched traced compute, 26 blocks with eight independent depth heads and two-block residual groups may support more compositional steps. Alternating short-window blocks with global reads should preserve sequence-wide retrieval.

candidates.title: lexical_canon_depth
candidates.hypothesis: Adding a context-gated causal bigram and trigram lookup to the embedding source should improve lexical generalization while preserving the single-query depth routing of the strongest published BPB architecture.

candidates.title: lexical_canon_depth
candidates.hypothesis: At 512 matched research updates, growing each table from 131071 to 524287 rows improved the four-head lexical routing model from 0.901842 to 0.900700 dev BPB. The single-query Canon lexical model reached 0.896276 with smaller tables. Combining its depth trunk with the larger lookup should reduce hash collisions at similar active compute.

candidates.title: lexical_stream_canon
candidates.hypothesis: At 2048 updates the fourfold table increase improved the matched four-head models by 0.001059 dev BPB. The separately tested lexical multi-stream Canon trunk scored 0.806381. Giving its causal bigram/trigram embedding the same extra capacity should reduce destructive collisions while preserving multi-stream depth retrieval.

candidates.title: contextual_lexical_writes
candidates.hypothesis: Table enlargement helped some early models, but its 512-update Canon gain disappeared by 2048. Two additional context-gated reads from the same causal lexical dictionary may be more valuable than additional buckets: each writes into multi-stream residual history at a different semantic depth, with zero initial gain.
